subject.title: Amazon Fantasy Companion Phase 2: implementation, milestones, submission
subject.phase: Phase 2 (DEC-AFC-SD-023 P2-6/P2-7): product implementation from the approved spec, milestones M01..M13, submission readiness

repositories.landing: PR to main; rebase or merge commit; never squash, never force-push, never commit on local main

baseline.package: the five-artifact Phase 2 planning package in the plan directory, bound by implementation.json journey_settings.planning_review.candidate_digest
baseline.revision_note: PR #10 head (approved spec content, DEC-AFC-APPROVAL-ST5); the Orchestrator commits the package.

granting_owner_decisions_note: Proposed execution envelope. Integrated planning/tracking approval does not activate product execution; the current-task hold stays until a subsequent owner execution instruction. Explicit tracking approval may authorize P2-L01 only. Record the exact package and instruction before making any grant effective.

scope: Phase 2 slices of implementation.json within their write sets, dependencies and leases
Defect fixes dispatched on the bug-triager routes per DEC-AFC-SD-037 within write sets named by triage
Creating GitHub milestones M01..M13 exactly as approved (P2-L01)
Preparing (not publishing) one release per technical-wave checkpoint W1..W5 through release-process
actions: commit with the agent author identity
push lane branches, open pull requests, merge by rebase or merge commit after one Reviewer review, at most one repair round and a green gate
add the CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry at landing
run scan-software-supply-chain and install scanned tools (Android command-line tools and platform-tools, AWS SAM CLI, cfn-lint, pinned Python test dependencies) on the development host
adb to the owner's Fire TV stick on the local network: install and uninstall our debug and release APKs, input key events, screencap, screenrecord, dumpsys, getprop
sam build and sam deploy of backend/template.yaml to the owner's Free-plan account through the owner-configured named profile afc-dev, and run deployed tests against it
create GitHub milestones M01..M13 and read them back (P2-L01)

After explicit planning/tracking approval, create the reviewed P2-L01 work issues through the repository-applicable workflow: mandatory issue-label helper when policy covers the target, otherwise native GitHub creation with body/label/target preflight and saved-state readback; close only fully accepted work, leaving partial work open

scope: New product requirements or behavior outside the register (scope change returns to the owner)
Mode A sample footage or any companion video player (DEC-AFC-SD-035)
Hardware performance benchmarking or measured performance claims
actions: AWS account creation, plan upgrade, payment method or any paid-only service (C4)
credential creation, retrieval, printing or copying (Yahoo client secret, OAuth tokens, AWS keys); agents use the named profile and SSM by role only
Yahoo developer application and OAuth consent (owner)
LICENSE decision, repository visibility flip, release publication, video upload, Devpost submission, judge/reviewer access, external feedback (C9)
squash merge, force-push, commit on local main, git switch, destructive git on unmerged work
route or profile change outside the frozen profiles and their fallback conditions
upstream issue or PR to any third-party project

Current-task hold: no Phase 2 product/backend/spike/deployment execution from planning or tracking approval alone; owner must request the subsequent execution stage. P2-L01 tracking setup may be explicitly approved separately from that hold.
paths: any path outside the allowed list

role_grants.grant: dispatch, leases, landing (including the CHANGELOG.md entry), owner stops, milestone creation, release preparation

role_grants.role: Product Implementer / Test Implementer / Light Implementer
role_grants.grant: the write set of the dispatched slice only
read-only review of one candidate with OCR delegate mode and Reverify where applicable; no writes
read-only assessment and the evidence files named in their packets
the triage-named write set of one defect; review read-only

expiry_conditions: Phase 2 closeout recorded in the DoD Manifest
owner revocation or supersession of this envelope
a change to the approved package digest without owner re-approval

approval_receipt.package: Phase 2 package at the candidate digest in implementation.json

current_task_scope.tracking_setup: P2-L01 only after explicit integrated approval
current_task_scope.product_execution: held until subsequent owner execution instruction
current_task_scope.publication: separate owner authority; history/content scope review required
current_task_scope.filing_scope: Current personal repository is outside the AlphaZede helper scope; re-evaluate at action time, preserve the policy and use the target repository workflow with identical validation obligations.
